question: Choose the antonym of 'diligent':
solution:
The correct answer is: **Lazy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"diligent"** means someone who is hardworking and puts in consistent effort to accomplish their tasks. (परिश्रमी)
 
 
• **Example:** She is a diligent student who always completes her assignments on time.
 
 
 
• **"Lazy"** refers to someone who is unwilling to work or use energy and avoids effort. (आलसी)
 
 
• **Example:** He was too lazy to get up early and missed the bus.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'diligent'** is **'lazy'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Lazy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Meticulous** (सूक्ष्म): Showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise.
 
 
• **Example:** The artist was meticulous in painting the smallest details of the portrait.
 
 
 
• **Efficient** (सक्षम): Achieving maximum productivity with minimum wasted effort or expense.
 
 
• **Example:** The new machine is more efficient than the old one, saving both time and energy.
 
 
 
• **Hardworking** (मेहनती): Dedicated and putting a lot of effort into work or tasks.
 
 
• **Example:** Hardworking employees are the backbone of any successful company.
